Acceptance criterion: Valid entries appear in history and update the correct month.
Edit keeps one ID; delete asks for confirmation and updates totals.
Balance equals income minus needs minus wants in integer pence.
Reload retains valid state on the same origin; save failures are reported.
Labels, keyboard access and narrow-screen layout pass manual checks.
Chart and numerical values match the same calculated totals.
Each month retains its own limits; zero means no limit.
History search and controls operate on the selected month.
Valid JSON round-trips; invalid backup leaves records unchanged.
Automated results retained; manual checks recorded honestly.
Requirements, schedule, meeting records and decisions are traceable.
Each member can explain their contribution and project limitations.
